title: Compact isolated evidence reducer for ambiguous bug tracing
hypothesis: On ambiguous repository bug tracing, a no-tool child constrained to a small citation-and-target envelope can give Sol enough navigation evidence to preserve correctness while reducing total cost; Luna can perform this bounded extraction more cheaply than Terra.
falsified_if: Any delegate treatment loses a deterministic hard gate, activates on simple_prompt, fails to activate on at least two of three bug runs, costs at least as much as parent-only Sol, or increases median bug latency by more than 10%.
deterministic_outcomes: all existing bug-investigation hard gates remain authoritative
the child receives only the explicit bounded file packet and has no tools
compact output is capped at 3000 bytes and retains cited navigation targets
simple_prompt completes without tools or delegation
efficiency_outcomes: delegate activation and child prompt and output tokens
elapsed time and parent-plus-child estimated API cost
decision_rule: Reject a profile for any correctness or isolation regression. Otherwise require zero simple_prompt delegate calls, delegate activation in at least two of three ambiguous_bug_investigation runs, lower median estimated_total_api_cost_usd than parent_only, and no more than 10% higher median elapsed_ms. Promote at most the cheaper passing compact profile, only for a subsequent targeted routing experiment; do not enable general delegation from this result.
